name: Source Trail
description: The trail of sources an agent opened while researching, arriving one by one under the query.

props.name: query
props.description: What the agent searched for, shown in quotes in the header.

props.name: sources
props.type: { title: string; domain: string; status: "reading" | "done"; href?: string }[]
props.description: The pages in the order they were opened. Each gets a letter tile tinted from its domain. A source with an href is a link.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the sources are shown at first (uncontrolled). Collapsed, the header shows the first tiles and a count.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the header is pressed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the block. Other props go to the root section element.
